assessment: Inventory and recipe coverage only. Behavior parity, browser checks and installation require executed evidence.

obligations.name: AccessList
obligations.behavior: Framed List of member link rows with selection; contained FloatingActionBar revokes; owner unselectable

obligations.name: Accordion
obligations.behavior: Radix accordion semantics, oriented arrow navigation, trigger/content relationships, reduced motion height, preserve optional mounted form state

obligations.name: ActivityLog
obligations.behavior: Plain small List with day sections and load more

obligations.name: Alert
obligations.behavior: Dismissible or persistent inline concern; error uses alert and other status uses polite announcement; Banner is standing condition
acceptance: Banner link remains readable in both themes

obligations.name: AlertDialog
obligations.behavior: Safe initial focus; exact confirmText gates destructive action; Escape and Cancel close; backdrop does not close; async pending/failure must preserve safe focus

obligations.name: AnimatedCollapse
obligations.behavior: 200ms grid-row height/fade after user choice; no first-paint animation; lazy mounts once; closed content leaves keyboard and accessibility tree; open overflow never clips portals

obligations.name: Announcements
obligations.behavior: 480px dialog of cards that slide in the direction of travel; Left and Right wrap; Next becomes Done; onSeen per card

obligations.name: ApprovalQueue
obligations.behavior: Framed List with actions below each request; requests change state in place
acceptance: Failed rows say how to recover

obligations.name: AspectRatio
obligations.behavior: Reserve media ratio without intrinsic sizing shift; child overflow policy explicit
acceptance: No content clipping that conceals focus

obligations.name: Avatar
obligations.behavior: Initials or identity glyphs, no photos; 20/24/32/40 px common sizes; AvatarGroup +N overflow and Identity layout; org kind exists in reference but active repo policy forbids org avatars
acceptance: Presence paired with text when meaningful

obligations.name: Badge
obligations.behavior: Badges are labels, never buttons; live state includes word and dot; Count is attention chip with on-accent text; status cannot rely on hue
acceptance: Status words remain with color removed
Long label does not overlap nearby title

obligations.name: Breadcrumb
obligations.behavior: Ancestors link, last crumb marks current unless title follows; middle collapse expands in place; product crumbs host Switcher; long labels truncate without wrapping product bar

obligations.name: Button
obligations.behavior: One strongly emphasized lime Button per task region; default/primary/accent share the authored face, clipped lower-edge light and inward bloom without texture, shadows or lift; stable-width pending feedback; icon-only requires accessible name and tooltip; native semantics for button versus anchor. Default/sm32 aliases, explicit md36/lg40 and xs24; text controls use 14px labels.

obligations.name: ButtonGroup
obligations.behavior: Related action geometry; toolbar accessible label; split primary and dropdown; safe action before primary in footer; segmented choice belongs Tabs

obligations.name: Calendar
obligations.behavior: React DayPicker selection semantics, locale date names and native Date precision, keyboard dates and safe unavailable state

obligations.name: Card
obligations.behavior: Tint shell with inset surface; plain object header composed Item; Tile is selectable card button; shared Media; min text 160px and tile floor 208px; footer wraps

obligations.name: Carousel
obligations.behavior: Embla-backed carousel, named region/slide position and keyboard arrows; no autoplay requirement

obligations.name: Chart
obligations.behavior: Typed chart config and accessible textual data alternative; scoped tokens; zero/missing values distinct

obligations.name: Checkbox
obligations.behavior: Controlled or default checked; mixed parent click selects all; native/Radix checkbox semantics and form label wiring

obligations.name: Code
obligations.behavior: Neutral tokenized machine text; shell/env/json/yaml/js-ts/python/hcl aliases; line numbers never copied; highlight accent-wash; long unbroken tokens scroll; safe text rendering

obligations.name: CodeBlock
obligations.behavior: Framed mono label middle-truncates keeping suffix; Copy last; source copy excludes prompts/numbers; Json child copy must use same recursively redacted model as display
acceptance: JSON string and object redact equally

obligations.name: Collapsible
obligations.behavior: Radix disclosure trigger/content semantics; complement AnimatedCollapse visual utility without duplicate ownership

obligations.name: Combobox
obligations.behavior: Case-insensitive anywhere-label search; accent highlight; create named query last; removable multi chips; Backspace empty removes last chip; typed mode-specific value/callback

obligations.name: CommandMenu
obligations.behavior: mod+K toggle; grouped label-first ranking and keywords; server search callback/page id; grouped limits/searchOnly; Up/Down or CtrlN/P wrap; modEnter new-tab link; nested Escape returns then closes
acceptance: Stale search cannot replace new results

obligations.name: ContextMenu
obligations.behavior: Radix context menu, keyboard ContextMenu/ShiftF10 where host exposes it; focus return and nested dismissal

obligations.name: Cover
obligations.behavior: Brand cover from color, radius and space tokens at a fixed ratio

obligations.name: DataGrid
obligations.behavior: ARIA grid separate from Table; typed column headers/gutter; pointer and keyboard ranges; Enter/F2/type edit, Escape cancels, Enter/Tab commit/move; atomic cell change batches; null versus empty exact; TSV copy/paste, resize/fit; id-based state and bounded virtual rendering. rowHeight defaults to a requested32 minimum; one observed content floor drives the uniform effective cell/virtual/navigation metric.
acceptance: Copy excludes sensitive values unless explicit permission

obligations.name: Dialog
obligations.behavior: Named focused task on scrim; first field initial focus; trap and restore focus; normal Escape/backdrop close; explicit pending dismissal policy; 440px default

obligations.name: Drawer
obligations.behavior: Vaul gesture drawer within React18 stack; named modal, focus and scroll restoration; direction token geometry. DrawerBody forwards native div props/ref and owns the shared inset and bounded scroll region; arbitrary Content children remain supported.

obligations.name: DropdownMenu
obligations.behavior: Arrow keys navigate; Enter action; checkbox/radio remain open; Escape restores trigger; submenu direction; foreground-tint hover; float outside clipping container
acceptance: No raw menu copied with custom trap

obligations.name: EmptyState
obligations.behavior: Title names missing object/place; fastest next step; compact clear-filter recovery; neutral icon tile and text; no generic No data

obligations.name: Field
obligations.behavior: One control with id/label/description/error wiring; group uses semantic legend; error replaces help and marks invalid; validate blur or submit

obligations.name: FileTree
obligations.behavior: ARIA tree one tab stop; visible Up/Down, Right open/enter, Left close/parent, Home/End/typeahead; disabled folder visible/focusable with reason; selected ancestors open; 16px indent

obligations.name: FloatingActionBar
obligations.behavior: Shows while count above zero; toolbar arrows; Escape clears; focus returns when it leaves

obligations.name: HoverCard
obligations.behavior: Supplementary linked preview, keyboard/focus accessibility; no essential controls available only on hover

obligations.name: Icon
obligations.behavior: 51 source path icons at 24 grid, 1.7 stroke, currentColor; controls16/navigation18/small14; semantic label only when standalone; checks2.6

obligations.name: Input
obligations.behavior: Native text input forwarding; focus border ink+nudge; read-only lock; trailing slots 24/28/32 with 4 gap; plaintext never receives secret; SecretInput masked reveal/copy companion. Default/sm32, md36, lg40; numeric native size remains a width hint.
acceptance: Reveal absent plaintext DOM until requested

obligations.name: InputGroup
obligations.behavior: One addon per side; trailing unit and hints not instructions; joined action acts on current value; copy-only field uses Snippet; shared control geometry. Defaultsm32, md36 and lg40 hosts with 24/28/32 nested action slots.

obligations.name: InputOtp
obligations.behavior: input-otp one-time-code input with actual input semantics, paste/autofill, safe char filtering

obligations.name: Item
obligations.behavior: Box-free object layout; title truncates before metadata; main text floor160px; actions move below or remain below across states; List owns current/selected and row behavior

obligations.name: Json
obligations.behavior: Pretty JSON expandable nodes with counts, guide16px and AnimatedCollapse; recursively redact matched scalar/object/array before rendering or copy; invalid JSON plain code may not bypass requested redaction
acceptance: Malformed input with redact fails closed

obligations.name: Kbd
obligations.behavior: mod glyph follows platform; one cap per key; sequences named then; screen readers hear key names; actual app bindings only
acceptance: No empty caps for plus key

obligations.name: Label
obligations.behavior: Radix label associates exact native control id; Field remains preferred composed contract

obligations.name: List
obligations.behavior: List owns row behavior; title stretched target excludes controls; link click opens and checkbox selects; static selected row toggles; select all excludes ineligible; arrows/Home/End skip disabled while Tab reaches actions

obligations.name: Loader
obligations.behavior: Region wrapper around a labeled Spinner; renders children when not loading

obligations.name: Menubar
obligations.behavior: Radix desktop application menubar navigation and focus transfer; no global shortcut binding implied

obligations.name: MiddleTruncate
obligations.behavior: Binary-fit text preserving suffix; remeasure on width/font change; full text for screen reader and copy; no secret values
acceptance: Narrow floor still preserves meaningful ends

obligations.name: MultiSelect
obligations.behavior: Button listbox, immediate picks; single closes; multi remains open; UpDown/HomeEnd/typeahead and SpaceEnter; modA toggles all eligible; disabled options unchanged; stable option order and polite count. Defaults to sm32, with explicit md36.

obligations.name: MultiStep
obligations.behavior: Ordered steps that validate before advancing; Back keeps values; last step names the action
acceptance: Invalid step focuses its first invalid field

obligations.name: NavigationMenu
obligations.behavior: Radix navigation landmark and menu/link distinction; pointer/focus panels; no application route migration

obligations.name: PageHeader
obligations.behavior: Page-level trail of ancestors above one h1; lede, actions beside the title that wrap under it, tabs below

obligations.name: Pagination
obligations.behavior: Total/range left, controls right; numbered gaps, ink current square; compact PageNofM; load-more live count; controlled/default page

obligations.name: Popover
obligations.behavior: Small task with own Save; Escape/outside closes without save; focus restored; collision-aware and scoped portal; discard semantics owner-controlled

obligations.name: Progress
obligations.behavior: Real counts preferred;6px track; auto warn80%,bad100%; over-limit text; known current sequence uses hatched steps

obligations.name: RadioGroup
obligations.behavior: Radix mutually exclusive selection and native form semantics

obligations.name: Resizable
obligations.behavior: react-resizable-panels typed v4Group/Panel/Separator API; pointer/keyboard resize and bounds

obligations.name: ScrollArea
obligations.behavior: Radix scrolling content without concealing keyboard focus; no duplicated scroll containers

obligations.name: Select
obligations.behavior: Short one-value list; keyboard listbox and chosen check; updown trigger; group headings; options retain separate label/description/check lanes; default/sm32 aliases, md36 and lg40

obligations.name: SensitiveEditor
obligations.behavior: SensitiveEditor defers value retrieval; SecretInput displays plaintext already held by the host. Owner controls permission, fetch and persistence; foundation owns explicit reveal/copy intent, scoped plaintext lifetime, editing/focus and status. No plaintext in DOM, title, aria, diagnostics, fixture files or generic grid clipboard before explicit permitted reveal. Preserve bytes including whitespace/newlines; Escape cancels; async failure retains draft only under current authorized editor lifetime. No authorization claims from masking. CopyButton supports size sm/md/lg host32/36/40 to action24/28/32, defaultsm, and iconOnly defaultfalse with a retained accessible label.
acceptance: Initial masked DOM/a11y/title contains no plaintext
Reveal only after explicit authorized owner success
Race result cannot reveal a different secret
Multiline whitespace and large value preserved
Grid selection/copy cannot bypass sensitive-cell policy

obligations.name: Separator
obligations.behavior: 1px rule or labelled time break; semantic orientation unless decorative; do not double header border

obligations.name: SettingsCard
obligations.behavior: Fields in a form with a footer status and Save; rejection keeps values and shows the message

obligations.name: Sheet
obligations.behavior: 440px right detail/edit overlay; list remains visible; own scrolling body; danger entry left/safe+save right; trap/restore and named dialog. SheetBody forwards native div props/ref and owns the shared inset and bounded scroll region; arbitrary Content children remain supported.

obligations.name: Sidebar
obligations.behavior: Tools row, labeled sections with rules, one level of children, accent counts for waiting items, account button with the person's avatar and the organization's name, rail with tooltips and dots

obligations.name: Skeleton
obligations.behavior: Reserve known layout with soft pulse; hide skeleton itself, label busy region; delay about300ms

obligations.name: Slider
obligations.behavior: Radix slider with labelled individual thumbs, value constraints, keyboard increment and page/HomeEnd

obligations.name: Snippet
obligations.behavior: Read-only one-line mono field; prompt excluded copy; ellipsis unfocused, caret scroll focused; clipboard success only after resolved write; no secret values. Defaultsm32 and explicit md36 with 24/28 nested copy actions.

obligations.name: Spinner
obligations.behavior: Infinity pixel mark, currentColor inline and mark base/page; two pixels1.2s,mark1.6/2.4s; page assembles once; label adds visible text in one polite status; page may add a description; delay holds the indicator back
acceptance: One status announcement, none from a decorative mark
Reduced motion full mark/two equal pixels

obligations.name: Switch
obligations.behavior: Instant setting, not submit checkbox; on ink track/lime knob light, lime track/black knob dark; native/Radix switch semantics; no Save with instant switch
acceptance: Async owner pending/failure recovery retains state

obligations.name: Table
obligations.behavior: Semantic table of objects, not grid; fit columns min64, capped values recoverable; one growing track;48px rows; actions last32px pinned; stable row ids; controlled sorting/selection; virtual fixed columns; append loading and counts. rowHeight defaults to a requested48 minimum; observed enlarged content raises one uniform effective row/slice/spacer metric.

obligations.name: Tabs
obligations.behavior: One sliding indicator200ms; reserve selected label width; firstpaint/resize/fontload/reducedmotion jump; edge fades only hiding tabs; wheel scroll releases at edge; automatic panels follow arrow focus

obligations.name: Textarea
obligations.behavior: Native multiline control with Field wiring and correct textarea ref, separate from Input shortcut

obligations.name: Toast
obligations.behavior: Bottom-right newest bottom; theme toast colors; loading no dismiss; errors persist; success about5sec; action accent-fg not yellow text light; polite/alert semantics
acceptance: Loading changes status without losing action

obligations.name: Toggle
obligations.behavior: Radix toggle is aria-pressed action, not Tabs or Checkbox replacement. Default/sm32 aliases, md36 and lg40.

obligations.name: ToggleGroup
obligations.behavior: Radix pressed-choice group semantics; use Tabs for peer panels. Shared Toggle size API supports default/sm32 aliases, md36 and lg40.

obligations.name: Tooltip
obligations.behavior: Hover300ms/focus immediate; noninteractive label; portal avoids clipping and flips; one focusable child; disabled reason outside disabled trigger

obligations.name: TopBar
obligations.behavior: Product-level trail of switcher crumbs rooted at the organization name; shared page gutter so the root crumb aligns with the content edge; chevron is the only highlighted element
acceptance: Root crumb text on the content edge at every width
